title: Clear the Field
text: Choose a non-leader unit that costs 3 or less. Return it and each enemy non-leader unit with the same name as it to their owners' hands.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card's cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Abilities that refer to a card's “name” do not include the subtitle of the card.
Clear the Field requires you to choose a unit in play and only returns units in play to hand.
